shared: Lights lure enemy attacks off target, and the top cards make the enemy army hit itself.
differ: Where the misdirection lives: lanterns on your units, lights in empty slots, or fight-start tricks.

takes.label: Lantern-carrying front row
takes.line: Units carry Lanterns that turn swings back on the enemy; Old Will aims them at its biggest unit, so their strength backfires.
takes.look_if: the enemy's own carry to kill its other carry.

takes.label: Treasure in the gaps
takes.line: Lights in empty slots soak wasted swings while stats pile up beneath; filling the slot cashes the whole pile into one carry.
takes.look_if: to weigh every empty slot, saving up for a big reveal.

takes.label: Dodges and dirty tricks
takes.line: Fight-start tricks steer enemies Astray, Gaffer flips a 2/12 wall into a 12/2, and Flit units dodge into gaps that grow them.
takes.look_if: Start of Combat combos and units that dodge hits.
